title: James Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on James 4: where fighting comes from, asking wrongly, and a life that is a vapor.

questions.text: According to verse 1, where do the wars and fightings among them come from?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 asks where the wars and fightings come from, and answers: from your pleasures that war in your members.

questions.text: According to the end of verse 2, what is the reason they do not have?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 ends by saying: you don't have, because you don't ask.

questions.text: Why do they ask and not receive, according to verse 3?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says they ask and don't receive because they ask with wrong motives, to spend it on their pleasures.

answers.text: They ask in the wrong place

questions.text: What is friendship with the world, according to verse 4?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says that friendship with the world is hostility toward God, and whoever wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.

questions.text: What does the saying quoted in verse 6 say God does to the proud?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 quotes: God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.

questions.text: What will the devil do if they resist him?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says: resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

questions.text: In verse 8, who are told to purify their hearts?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says: cleanse your hands, you sinners; purify your hearts, you double-minded.

questions.text: According to verse 11, the one who judges his brother also judges what?
questions.explanation: Verse 11 says that he who speaks against a brother and judges his brother speaks against the law and judges the law.

questions.text: What does verse 14 compare their life to?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says: for what is your life? For you are a vapor that appears for a little time, and then vanishes away.

questions.text: What does verse 17 say about the one who knows to do good and does not do it?
questions.explanation: Verse 17 says that to him who knows to do good, and doesn't do it, to him it is sin.
